thread:
raj.patel: Quick heads-up — we just discovered a partner ingestion job that pulled KMS-wrapped ciphertext for a vault blob it shouldn't have. Not a full key compromise, but leaking ciphertext + SA token. Proposing a short plan: create a transient wrapping key, rewrap affected ciphertext, blacklist the offending consumer principal, and evict leases. Need ops + infra help.

maria-sec: ack. can you paste the artifact IDs and affected paths?

raj.patel: Path: secret/data/partner-ingest/*; wrapped ciphertext sample: gcp:kms:projects/…/locations/global/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/ingest-key:ciphertext...

eli-sre: first priority — revoke any active dynamic leases for that path so tokens can't read new values. run: `vault lease revoke -prefix=secret/data/partner-ingest/`

tayler-infra: agree. also want to avoid rotating the main KMS key immediately because it impacts all partners. propose: create a transient vault transit key `transient-handoff-<ts>`, rewrap those specific ciphertext blobs under that transit key, and rotate the service to require the new wrapping key for unwrapping. minimizes blast radius.

sam-devex: how do you rewrap ciphertext from AWS/GCP KMS to Vault transit? need a quick script or runbook we can use.

maria-sec: high-level steps: 1) generate ephemeral wrapping key in Vault transit: `vault write -f transit/keys/transient-handoff-1709501234` 2) use offline rewrap flow: fetch ciphertext from store, call vault transit/rewrap (or decrypt via current KEK and re-encrypt under transit), replace artifact. If we can't decrypt (no plaintext), create an envelope layer: wrap existing ciphertext blob with transit by encrypting the ciphertext as plaintext under transit key. That way unwrapping requires both layers.

eli-sre: exact command sketch (for team use, validate with infra):
```
# create ephemeral transit key
vault write -f transit/keys/transient-handoff-1709501234
# wrap the existing ciphertext blob as a payload under transit
vault write transit/encrypt/transient-handoff-1709501234 plaintext=$(echo -n '<base64_original_ciphertext>' | base64)
# store ciphertext output back to the artifact store
```

tayler-infra: good. after wrapping, we update the accessor policies so that only our rewrap service can call transit/decrypt on `transient-handoff*`. then blacklist the offending consumer principal in IAM (deny binding) and revoke any long-lived SA keys. For GCP: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=svc@partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and add a deny policy. For AWS: create an SCP or explicit deny in the account/role.

maria-sec: also enable an immediate Vault audit device if not already on for this cluster: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault-audit-partner-ingest.log` so every API call is recorded. we need the audit trail to show who accessed the wrap/unwrap endpoints.

raj.patel: ops-bot kicked off a quick sweep that found 7 active leases and 3 long-lived service keys.

ops-bot: Incident job started: secret-sweep(1709501234) — revoking leases and listing SA keys. status: leases_found=7 sa_keys_found=3

eli-sre: i'll take leases. running `vault lease revoke -prefix=secret/data/partner-ingest/` now.

tayler-infra: i'll create the transient transit key and lock its policy. then I'll post the rewrap endpoint and creds in the ops runbook channel.

sam-devex: i'll prepare a short script to perform the envelope-wrap so we don't need plaintext: `tools/rewrap_envelope.sh --input-blob-id $BLOB --transit-key transient-handoff-1709501234` and push to `deploy-tools` for manual run.

maria-sec: after blacklist and rewrap: run a credential sweep across logs (partner ingestion logs, artifact store access) and rotate any vault tokens that were scoped to partner-ingest. use `scripts/cred_sweep.sh --match=partner-ingest` and post results here.

raj.patel: timeline request: can we do initial containment in next 30m? who can own the blacklist?

tayler-infra: i'll own blacklist. i'll add an IAM deny for the offending principal and attach a policy at org level if needed. ETA 20m.

eli-sre: leases are revoked — `leases_revoked=7`. posting command output to #eng-oncall.

sam-devex: rewrap script ready in the repo, but need infra token to call `vault transit/encrypt`. @tayler-infra please provide a short-lived machine token (1h) pinned to the rewrap policy.

tayler-infra: created token `s.rewrap-202311-1h` with policy `rewrap-only` and TTL=1h. posted in the private runbook channel.

maria-sec: once rewraps are done, we'll schedule immediate rotation for any long-lived SA keys found. also escalate to legal/security if partner data exfil under review.

raj.patel: after rewrap finished (sam) we'll run an integrity check: try to unwrap with both the old path and new transit-unwrap to ensure the envelope is correct. sample check: `vault write transit/decrypt/transient-handoff-1709501234 ciphertext=<rewrapped>` should return base64 of original ciphertext.

sam-devex: rewrap completed for 12 blobs. pushed results to `s3://redwood-incident/1709501234/rewrap-manifest.json` (manifest includes blob ids and checksums).

tayler-infra: blacklist done: IAM deny applied to svc@partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com across project boundary. disabled 2 SA keys in GCP and revoked 1 AWS access key.

ops-bot: Incident job update: leases_revoked=7 rewraps_completed=12 sa_keys_disabled=3 blacklist_applied=true

maria-sec: next steps: 1) rotate any remaining KEKs if audit shows access beyond expected 2) run forensics on partner logs (eli) 3) update customers/partners as per policy (pm/legal) 4) create a short postmortem and harden onboarding gating for blob access.

eli-sre: forensics kickoff started — pulling access logs and audit trails. tagging artifacts with `incident:1709501234`. posting findings within 48h.

raj.patel: thanks all. AP: eli - forensics, tayler - blacklist + token provisioning, sam - rewrap tool + manifest, maria - audit + rotation plan. please update this thread when each step is done. :thumbsup:

sam-devex: updating final checklist now — will ping when manifest verified and integrity checks pass.

ops-bot: Incident job complete: all containment actions done. follow-up tasks created in JIRA: INFSEC-1709, SRE-4312, DEVEX-229.
